Every test file that imports a production module the node changed adds no failure against a base arm: run both arms from git archive extractions on node-local disk with the main checkout's .env linked, record both logs, and re-run any id that differs between arms serially three times on each revision. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Run the gate in the foreground on the fleet allocation.
